Definition: A DEL-10-02 framework that validates adapter declarations and fixtures without parsing real external files or selecting a concrete format.
Mandatory boolean controls adapters cannot disable (e.g. must_use_public_api_boundary, must_preserve_provenance, must_not_access_network).
Flags asserting human review is required and that software makes no compliance, certification, sealing, approval, or authentication claims.
Notes: Recurs across adapters, constraints, analysis runs, comparison, and GUI surfaces.

Definition: Source attribution metadata: source_name, source_location, source_license, contributor, contributor_certification, redistribution_status, review_status, privacy_classification.
An immutable DEL-14-02 record wrapping a preview mechanics result with provenance, diagnostics, result hashes, and professional-boundary flags.
Policy marking run records read-only; changes create a new analysis run and the hash invalidates external acceptance.
A local SQLite project store acting as an index projection over the canonical JCS JSON payload, with no public SQL contract and no network requirement.
Notes: Held TBD as an adapter decision in REQUIRED_TBD_DECISIONS.

Definition: Serialization with sorted keys and compact separators used for stable, replayable hashing.
A normalized difference between two mapped analysis-run results with dimension, unit, magnitudes, deltas, tolerance refs, and classification.
Caller-supplied tolerance values keyed by result family and dimension used to classify deltas as within or exceeding tolerance.
Deterministic DEL-14-03 comparison of two immutable model states producing a diff envelope of entity rows and diagnostics.
An entity identifier resolved from reference.ref or stable_id, entity_id, id, or ref, required for every compared entity.
A classification of a constraint such as connectivity, clearance, no_go_volume, support_zone, route_conflict, slope, drain, vent, access, equipment_interface, or missing_required_data.
The accepted dimension identifiers (length, force, moment, pressure, stress, slope, linear_stiffness, etc.) plus TBD.
A stable provenance-aware decision-support diagnostic with code, severity, class, affected/source references, message, and remediation.
A deterministic DEL-07-06 contract-level review of GUI contract records with no live desktop runtime evaluation.
Already-built per-deliverable GUI surface records consumed by the accessibility reviewer without running a desktop GUI.
Restricted phrases (e.g. allowable stress table, stress intensification factor table, vendor catalog value) screened to keep public records limited to invented metadata.
A deterministic identifier hashed from a finding's content used to dedupe accessibility findings.
